title: Reconcile the published V4 Guards 1.1.4 release lineage into the development base
goal: Merge the unmerged codex/v4-guards-1.1.4-release lineage into codex/v4-development-base so the canonical V4 source and the V4-TODO-008 history export contain the published 1.1.4 product without rewriting any release.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-fast-forward merge of release branch tip 3641d81eecea59b00234e804a1c19ccf7ec04982 has the development base and the 1.1.4 release lineage as parents.

Every conflicting V4 product file resolves to the published 1.1.4 content, and the merged docs/guards/v4 tree equals the 3641d81e tree except for development-only V4 plans and the two IFX cutover integration files.
Package integrity, Windows-full platform certification and V4 native plan validation pass on a tree-identical clean trial merge, and the live merge commit reproduces the validated tree object.
No release, tag, asset, V3/V3_ifx file, workflow, ruleset or IFX application source changes, and nothing is pushed without separate authorization.
risks: A conflict resolution could silently drop development-only content or reintroduce pre-release behavior.
Hash-bound integrity records (module, registry, compatibility baseline, CI contract) could disagree after a partial resolution.
Validation on a trial clone could be mistaken for validation of a different live tree.
decisions: Resolve README.md, modules/registry.json, modules/synthetic-probe/adapter.ps1 and modules/synthetic-probe/module.json to the published 1.1.4 release content.
Keep development-only V4 plans and the IFX cutover proposal/specimen unchanged.
Leave v4-guards-v1.1.4 at 2185477ba89d7a3cef95c99bfe737bf98a70f39d and every other release unchanged.
Bind the V4-TODO-008 history export to this merge commit through Amendment A2.
Push only under a separate explicit authorization.
